manual_topics.text:
# Alpha

The sample project exports a local command line entrypoint.

# Bravo

Release archives contain public runtime files and license notices.

# Charlie

The synthetic package uses a standard library configuration reader.

# Delta

The example service starts on a loopback address.

# Echo

Use a disposable workspace for integration fixtures.

# Note ownership

自动维护采用托管块局部更新。人工正文由用户维护，工具保留人工段落。

# Persistence

SQLite 索引重建从 Markdown 原文读取；索引只是可重新生成的派生数据。

# Transport

The client uses exponential backoff jitter after a temporary network error.

# Module map

Cache eviction is implemented in src/worker/cache.py, under the local worker package.

# Socket startup

EADDRINUSE: address already in use. The listener reports the occupied port.

# 知识检索

查询结果带片段、来源和可继续读取的位置。

# Scheduling

Timers run only in the local process.

# Operator notes

This note will receive an explicit human edit during the evaluation.
